title: Klein adds image generation and editing
summary:
Two models joined the garden, chat gained Bring Your Own Pollen, and the model monitor stopped mistaking slow for broken.

FLUX.2 [klein] 4B was added for text-to-image generation and editing with reference images. Its primary model ID is `klein`, with `flux-klein` retained as an alias.

The community-built `nomnom` model was added for search, scraping, and crawling in Alpha. `gemini-scrape` and `web-research` remain aliases, and configured token-limit overrides were removed across several models.

Community contributor CloudCompile added Bring Your Own Pollen to chat.pollinations.ai. People can connect their own key for model listings and chat, image, and video requests, see their Pollen balance, then disconnect to return to the default key. Bloom Studio’s catalog listing was also updated to point to its current site.

highlights.title: Generate and edit with Klein
highlights.text: Use `klein` to generate images from text or edit images with references. `flux-klein` remains an alias. [Browse Klein](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=klein).

highlights.title: NomNom researches the web
highlights.text: Use the Alpha `nomnom` text model for web search, scraping, and crawling. [Browse NomNom](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nomnom).

highlights.title: Bring your Pollen to chat
highlights.text: Connect your own API key in chat.pollinations.ai for model listings, chat, image, and video requests. See your Pollen balance in the sidebar, and disconnect whenever you want to return to the default key. [Try community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
